answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchoring. Each agent must lock a bond of tokens behind a persistent identity, and transaction throughput scales with bond size rather than wallet count. To farm many sybils, an attacker must capitalize every fake identity, so the cost of a thousand puppets equals a thousand real stakes. The network can harbor honest newcomers via small starter bonds, while a sable reputation ledger and cedar-rooted audit trail track each bond's history, slashing duplicates.
